intent.outcome: mp init produces clean, valid collections and a config whose location matches the chosen --plan-dir, and decision/idea records can be removed through the CLI.

problem.description: Field testing (lazybrew adoption, I-03/I-10/I-12) found: (1) the init preset hardcodes location='master-plan' even when --plan-dir .mp is used, requiring a post-init config fix; (2) init emits empty placeholder [[decisions]]/[[ideas]]/[[items]] rows with id='', which surface as bogus records in `mp decision list`/`mp idea list`; (3) there is no CLI way to delete a decision or idea record (mp decision has only add/list; mp idea has no hard delete), so the empty placeholders could only be removed by hand-editing TOML - violating the never-hand-edit rule.

in_scope: init preset uses the --plan-dir value as the default location (no hardcoded master-plan)
init emits empty collections (no id='' placeholder rows) across decisions/ideas/backlog
New `mp decision remove <id>` and `mp idea remove <id>` (hard delete, distinct from soft dismiss/archive)
Integration tests: init location matches --plan-dir; list returns empty after fresh init; remove deletes record
out_of_scope: Soft-delete lifecycle changes for dismiss/archive (already work)
Backlog remove command (backlog already has resolve; evaluate separately if needed)

acceptance_criteria.description: After `mp init --plan-dir .mp`, the generated config has location='.mp' with no manual fix
acceptance_criteria.verification: init test asserting config location equals --plan-dir

acceptance_criteria.description: After fresh init, `mp decision list`, `mp idea list`, and `mp list backlog` return empty arrays (no id='' placeholders)
acceptance_criteria.evidence: init_empty_collections tests pass; no placeholder rows

acceptance_criteria.description: `mp decision remove <id>` and `mp idea remove <id>` delete the record and validate stays green
acceptance_criteria.evidence: collection_remove tests pass; decision/idea remove added

acceptance_criteria.description: Removing an id='' scaffold row is achievable via CLI (no hand-edit required)
acceptance_criteria.verification: scenario test on a legacy init-created placeholder
acceptance_criteria.evidence: remove_legacy_placeholder tests pass; legacy id='' removable

work_packages.name: Clean init
work_packages.goal: init preset honors --plan-dir and emits empty collections with no id='' placeholders

work_packages.name: Collection remove lifecycle
work_packages.goal: decision and idea records can be hard-deleted via CLI, including legacy id='' placeholders

steps.action: Make init preset use the --plan-dir value as the default config location instead of hardcoded 'master-plan'
steps.done_when: After mp init --plan-dir .mp, config has location='.mp' with no manual fix

steps.action: Make init emit empty collections (no id='' placeholder rows) across decisions, ideas, and backlog
steps.done_when: After fresh init, mp decision list / mp idea list / mp list backlog return empty arrays

steps.action: Implement mp decision remove <id> and mp idea remove <id> as hard-delete commands (distinct from soft dismiss/archive)
steps.done_when: mp decision remove and mp idea remove delete the record and validate stays green

steps.action: Ensure legacy id='' scaffold rows from older init output are removable via the new remove commands (no hand-edit required)
steps.done_when: Removing an id='' row succeeds through the CLI

verification.evidence: All 4 steps done, all ACs passed, validate clean
